title: New orchestrator/machine.py: machine-wide leases and account usage ledger shared by every repo
spec:
Why: goal T-1403 W4. Accounts, Claude worker slots and gate resources (simulators, ports) are machine-wide, but each repo keeps its own STATE/pool_state.json (pool.py:13, 471-473), so three repos each believe they own the full Claude cap. This task only adds the module; wiring is later tasks (C1, C2, C4, C6).
Contract (exact):
- MACHINE_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("ORCH_MACHINE_DIR", "~/.orchestrator-machine")).expanduser(); files leases.json, accounts.json; all reads and writes under an fcntl flock on MACHINE_DIR/machine.lock; writes atomic (tmp + os.replace).
- acquire(kind: str, cap: int, holder: dict) -> str | None; holder = {"repo": str, "task": str, "pid": int}; sweeps dead pids of that kind first; returns a lease id (uuid4 hex) or None at cap.
- release(lease_id: str) -> None (idempotent).
- count(kind: str) -> int (sweeps dead pids first).
- record_usage(account_id: str, tokens: int, *, repo: str, planner: bool = False, now: float | None = None) -> None.
- usage(account_id: str, now: float | None = None) -> {"window_tokens": int, "day_tokens": int, "planner_window_tokens": int, "planner_day_tokens": int}; window 5 h rolling from the first record in the window, day = local calendar day (Europe/Zurich via time.localtime).
- Lease kinds used later: "claude_worker", "gate:<resource>".
Pure module: import only stdlib. Tests set ORCH_MACHINE_DIR to a temp dir.

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1403. Commit first, then run the focused acceptance test in the foreground (uv run python -m pytest <id> -q). Never background a command and never run the full gate; the daemon gates externally. Acceptance ids are tests/<file>.py::<function or method name>; write the test as a unittest.TestCase method using tests/_harness.py like the neighbouring tests.
acceptance: tests/test_machine.py::test_worker_slot_cap_spans_repos passes: two holders from different repo paths acquire claude_worker leases up to cap, the next acquire returns None, releasing one frees a slot, and a lease whose pid is dead is swept by count()

tests/test_machine.py::test_usage_ledger_sums_across_repos passes: record_usage from two repos for one account sums in usage(account) window and day totals, with rollover at the 5-hour window and the local day
